items.title: Cohomology of a module over a sheaf of rings agrees with cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the cohomology of a module over a sheaf of rings on a site agrees with the cohomology of its underlying abelian sheaf, both globally and over any object (statement lines 1861-1882). The proof reduces the comparison to the statement that an injective module is acyclic as an abelian sheaf (proof lines 1884-1900), which the author obtains from the vanishing criterion for cohomology over a cofinal system of coverings (proof lines 1903-1910), and then deduces both equalities, the global one requiring the case of a site with a final object (proof lines 1913-1919). The non-formal content is the acyclicity of injective modules viewed as abelian sheaves. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one criterion.
